g.text: ok 1 - cycle: starts on the reset day, clamps to short months, honours the time zone
ok 2 - pool choice: the soonest-expiring ready pool, falling back when it has no key, no credit or n
ok 3 - costOf: half price for batches, cache writes split 5 min / 1 h
ok 4 - budget refusals exit 3: a spent pool, and a worst case over the cap
ok 5 - --dry-run: every check, no network, says batch or real-time
ok 6 - batch path end to end: create, poll, results, one ledger row at half price
ok 7 - --now goes real-time at full price; so does a cycle ending within 26 h
ok 8 - a batch that outlives --wait-min is recorded as pending, reserved, then collected once
ok 9 - --jsonl sends many prompts as ONE batch; a failed request is reported per custom_id
ok 10 - --mcp-config: a clean config is passed last as an absolute path; credential-looking ones are
ok 11 - positive controls: the rejection check notices an accepted or leaky result, and a tool with
the check removed fails the cases
ok 12 - --print-args prints the claude argv and touches no pool, key or ledger
ok 13 - agent run: the key reaches only the child, through an env allow-list; the cost is booked
ok 14 - configuration errors exit 2: plain http to a remote host, a key pasted into key_env
ok 15 - no key value ever appears in stdout, stderr, the ledger or any run file

text.tspan: # offline: a local stub of the Messages and Batches API, a fake claude script, made-up keys
